Improvised.Name: Improvised Strike
Improvised.Title: Improvised Strike
Improvised.Choose: Which weapon is the closest match for what you're swinging?
Improvised.NoWeapons: No weapons were found in the system's item compendium.
Improvised.Description: An improvised attack using the damage and skill of a {weapon}.
Improvised.ActionDescription: Attack with an object you can pick up, or use a weapon in an unconventional way. Choose the Light or Heavy weapon it most resembles and strike with that weapon's damage and skill.

Settings.Name: Improvised Strike action
Settings.Hint: Give every character an Improvised Strike action that asks which weapon the improvised object stands in for, then makes that Strike without editing the sheet.
